setup_isaac_env: setup a bimanual Allegro hand Isaac Gym environment with PolyTraj task and initial qpos
convert_mujoco_to_isaac_ctrl: convert a 44-d MuJoCo control tensor to Isaac Gym left-first finger order
convert_isaac_to_mujoco_ctrl: convert a 44-d Isaac Gym control tensor back to MuJoCo right-first finger order
get_isaac_reward: get the reward for the Isaac Gym environment based on qpos and qvel tracking error
sync_isaac_env_state: broadcast the first environment state to all parallel Isaac Gym environments
